hero.lead: A spice house in {city} that cleans, grades and packs the spices South Indian kitchens use every day — the way they were made at home, sealed the way they should be now.

body.p1: It started with a simple complaint: the spices in the shops did not taste like the ones ground at home. So we went back to the source — Guntur for chilli, the Erode belt for turmeric — and to the old recipes, and began packing them ourselves in {city}.
body.p2: Every lot is cleaned and graded before it is ground, and checked again before it is sealed. Blends are roasted spice by spice and ground to a house recipe; single spices are one ingredient and nothing else.
body.p3: We pack in 500 g household sizes because that is what a kitchen that cooks every day goes through, and we seal and batch-code every pouch so you know exactly what you are getting.
body.title: Why we pack our own

values.title: What we hold ourselves to
values.v1Body: Bought from the regions known for each spice, and graded before anything is ground.
values.v2Body: Cleaned, roasted where the recipe asks, ground and checked at every stage.
values.v3Body: Heat-sealed, tamper-evident pouches with a batch code on every one.
values.v4Body: Household packs and honest blends for kitchens that cook every day.
